operation.description:
Checks if a user has permission to be assigned to a specific issue.

If the `assignee` can be assigned to this issue, a `204` status code with no content is returned.

Otherwise a `404` status code is returned.

204.description: Response if `assignee` can be assigned to `issue_number`

404.description: Response if `assignee` can not be assigned to `issue_number`

operation.summary: Check if a user can be assigned to a issue

#/components/parameters/issue-number.description: The number that identifies the issue.
#/components/parameters/issue-number.name: issue_number

#/components/parameters/owner.description: The account owner of the repository. The name is not case sensitive.
#/components/parameters/owner.name: owner

#/components/parameters/repo.description: The name of the repository without the `.git` extension. The name is not case sensitive.
#/components/parameters/repo.name: repo
